# Autonomous Web Research

## When to use
Use when the task requires conduct verifiable, dated research on legitimate online income models, platform rules and buyer demand.

## Procedure
Start with concrete claims and search queries; prefer primary sources; date every claim; cross-check consequential assertions; distinguish primary evidence, third-party anecdotes, and hypotheses. Output evidence register with URLs, observed date, quotation/paraphrase, confidence, and gaps. Don't scrape unauthorized content.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
